editorial:
Imagine you have a perfect plan to move illegal drugs across the city, but then you hop into a taxi with a driver who is even crazier than you are. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a drug mule who thinks he has everything under control until he meets a cab driver who just won't let him leave. The vibe is a wild mix of stress and laughs, making you feel like you are stuck in the backseat of that car for the whole ride. It starts off as a simple crime story, but it quickly turns into a strange game of cat and mouse where nobody is who they seem to be.

What really makes this work is how the tension builds up slowly while still keeping things funny. The acting is top-notch, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the payoff is totally worth it. You should definitely check this out if you love stories about criminals getting into messy situations.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the cab driver was not just a random guy, but someone with his own dark agenda and connection to the crime world. After a lot of fighting and arguing, the power dynamic shifts one last time. The movie wraps up with a shocking turn of events where the mule realizes he was never actually in control. It ends on a note that leaves you thinking about greed and bad luck.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tight thrillers with a sense of humor.
